title: Endless Lake
desc: Endless Lake turns a simple crossing into a timing challenge. Keep moving across narrow paths, judge each jump before the clock catches you and beat your best time in short, repeatable runs.
howto: Start the run and read the path ahead.
Time each movement across the narrow route.
Avoid falling into the endless lake.
Keep enough speed to beat the clock.
Restart quickly to improve your time.
tips: Commit to a jump only after reading the landing.
Learn the rhythm of each path.
